يستقطرون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْطِرُونَ (yastaqṭirūna) /jas.taq.tˤi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# يُسْتَقْطَرُونَ (yustaqṭarūna) /jus.taq.tˤa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
